concerns.text: Task T020a (Subset Selection) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly depends on T013d (Geometry Export) completion to filter molecules with valid optimized geometries. This creates a hidden ordering requirement: T020a cannot run until T013d finishes. The [P] tag is incorrect and misleading for parallel execution planning.

Task T020b-subset depends on T020a AND T013d. However, T020a itself depends on T013d. The dependency chain is valid, but T020b-subset is marked [P] in the header (implied by Phase 4 structure) while it strictly requires the output of T020a. If T020a is not completed, T020b-subset cannot run. Ensure T020b-subset is not scheduled in parallel with T020a.

Task T030b-sweep depends on T030b-noise, which in turn depends on T021. T030b-sweep is marked [P] in the Phase 5 header context, but it cannot run until T030b-noise completes. The [P] tag suggests it can run in parallel with other Phase 5 tasks, but it has a strict sequential dependency on T030b-noise.

Phase 10 tasks (T121-T126) are marked [P] and listed as dependent on T035, T022, etc. However, T121-T126 are documentation updates that depend on the *results* of T022 and T035. While they can be parallelized *among themselves* once dependencies are met, the [P] tag in the Phase 10 header might imply they can run in parallel with the *execution* of T022/T035, which is impossible. Clarify that Phase 10 tasks are parallel-safe only *after* Phase 6/7 completion.

T004c-extract and T004c-normalize are split into two tasks but both are part of the same logical flow (extract then normalize). T004c-normalize depends on T004c-extract. The [P] tag on T004c-extract is correct, but T004c-normalize should not be marked [P] if it implies parallelism with T004c-extract. Ensure the dependency is clear.
